mechanism_narrative: A growing GDP indicates strong economic activity, which positively impacts corporate earnings and drives S&P 500 returns higher over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: GDP growth is positive, but SPX returns are negative over 60 days in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment above 4.5% signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE exceeds 4.5% but SPX shows positive 20-day returns more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When federal funds rate is high and unemployment is low, it indicates tight monetary policy, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: High FEDFUNDS and low UNRATE occur, but SPX returns are positive over 20 days in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, higher federal funds rates increase borrowing costs, reducing corporate profitability and S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: During tightening, FEDFUNDS rise but SPX returns remain positive over 20 days in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer prices erode profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL increases but SPX returns are positive over 20 days in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 indicates supply chain issues, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO falls below 100 but SPX returns remain positive over 60 days in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Declines in both housing starts and retail sales signal weak demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Both HOUST and RSAFS decline but SPX returns are positive over 20 days in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Slowing payroll growth indicates economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth is below 0.1% but SPX returns are positive over 5 days in more than 60% of cases.
